entries.title: II Kings 10:1
segments: And Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria. And Jehu wrote letters and sent to Samaria to the rulers of Jezreel, to the elders, and to the supporters of Ahab, saying,

entries.title: II Kings 10:2
segments: And now as soon as this letter comes to you, since your master's sons [are] with you, and with you [are] chariots and horses, also a fortified city and armor,

entries.title: II Kings 10:3
segments: even look for the best and fittest of your master's sons, and set [him] on his father's throne, and fight for your master's house.

entries.title: II Kings 10:4
segments: And they were exceedingly afraid and said, Behold, two kings did not stand before him; how then shall we stand?

entries.title: II Kings 10:5
segments: And he who [was] over the house, and he over the city, the elders also, and the guardians, sent to Jehu saying, We [are] your servants and will do all that you shall say to us; we will not make any king. Do what is good in your eyes.

entries.title: II Kings 10:6
segments: And he wrote a letter the second time to them, saying, If you [are] mine, and will listen to my voice, take the heads of the men, your master's sons, and come to me to Jezreel by this time tomorrow. And the king's sons, seventy persons, [were] with the great men of the city who brought them up.

entries.title: II Kings 10:7
segments: And it happened when the letter came to them, they took the king's sons and killed them, seventy persons, and put their heads in baskets and sent to him in Jezreel.

entries.title: II Kings 10:8
segments: And a messenger came and told him, saying, They have brought the heads of the king's sons. And he said, Lay them in two heaps at the entering in of the gate until the morning.

entries.title: II Kings 10:9
segments: And it happened in the morning, he went out and stood, and said to all the people, You [are] righteous. Behold, I plotted against my master and killed him. But who killed all these?

entries.title: II Kings 10:10
segments: Now know that there shall fall to the earth nothing of the word of the LORD, which the LORD spoke concerning the house of Ahab. For the LORD has done that which He spoke by His servant Elijah.

entries.title: II Kings 10:11
segments: And Jehu killed all that remained of the house of Ahab in Jezreel, and all his great men, and his familiar friends, and his priests, until he left him none remaining.

entries.title: II Kings 10:12
segments: And he arose and departed, and came to Samaria. He [was] at the shepherds' shearing-house in the way,

entries.title: II Kings 10:13
segments: And Jehu met with the brothers of Ahaziah king of Judah, and said, Who [are] you? And they answered, The brothers of Ahaziah. And we are going down to greet the king's sons and the queen's sons.

entries.title: II Kings 10:14
segments: And he said, Take them alive! And they took them alive and killed them at the pit of the shearing-house, forty-two men. And he left not a man of them.

entries.title: II Kings 10:15
segments: And he left there and found Jehonadab the son of Rechab [coming] to meet him. And [he] greeted him and said to him, [Is] your heart right, as my heart [is] with your heart? And Jehonadab answered, It is. If it is, give your hand. And he gave his hand. And he took him up to him into the chariot.

entries.title: II Kings 10:16
segments: And [he] said, Come with me and see my zeal for the LORD. And they made him ride in his chariot.

entries.title: II Kings 10:17
segments: And he came to Samaria, and killed all that remained to Ahab in Samaria, until he had destroyed him, according to the saying of the LORD which he spoke to Elijah.

entries.title: II Kings 10:18
segments: And Jehu gathered all the people together, and said to them, Ahab served Baal a little, [but] Jehu shall serve him much.

entries.title: II Kings 10:19
segments: And now call to me all the prophets of Baal, all his servants and all his priests. Let no one be lacking. For I have a great sacrifice to Baal. Whoever shall be lacking, he shall not live. But Jehu did [it] in subtlety, to the end that he might destroy the worshipers of Baal.

entries.title: II Kings 10:20
segments: And Jehu said, Call a solemn feast for Baal. And they called [it].

entries.title: II Kings 10:21
segments: And Jehu sent through all Israel. And all the worshipers of Baal came, so that there was not a man left who did not come. And they came into the house of Baal. And the house of Baal was full from one end to another.

entries.title: II Kings 10:22
segments: And he said to him who [was] over the robe-room, Bring out robes for all the worshipers of Baal. And he brought [them] out for them.

entries.title: II Kings 10:23
segments: And Jehu went, and Jehonadab the son of Rechab, into the house of Baal. And he said to the servants of Baal, Search and look, that there [may] not [be] here with you any of the servants of the LORD, but only the servants of Baal.

entries.title: II Kings 10:24
segments: And they went in to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings. And Jehu had appointed eighty men outside, and said, [If] any of the men whom I have brought into your hands escapes, his life shall be for the life of him.

entries.title: II Kings 10:25
segments: And it happened when he had made an end of offering the burnt offering, Jehu said to the guard and to the commanders, Go in. Kill them! Do not let any come out! And they struck them with the edge of the sword. And the guard and the commanders threw [them] out. And they went to the city, to the house of Baal.

entries.title: II Kings 10:26
segments: And they brought forth the images out of the house of Baal and burned them.

entries.title: II Kings 10:27
segments: And [they] broke down the image of Baal, and broke down the house of Baal and made it a sewer-house until this day.

entries.title: II Kings 10:28
segments: And Jehu destroyed Baal out of Israel.

entries.title: II Kings 10:29
segments: Only, Jehu did not depart [from] the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, going after them, the golden calves in Bethel and in Dan.

entries.title: II Kings 10:30
segments: And the LORD said to him, Jehu, because you have done well in doing the right in My eyes, and have done to the house of Ahab according to all that [was] in My heart, your sons of the fourth [generation] shall sit on the throne of Israel.

entries.title: II Kings 10:31
segments: But Jehu did not care to walk in the law of Jehovah God of Israel with all his heart, for he did not turn from the sins of Jeroboam, who made Israel to sin.

entries.title: II Kings 10:32
segments: In those days the LORD began to cut Israel short. And Hazael struck them in all the border of Israel,

entries.title: II Kings 10:33
segments: from Jordan toward the rising of the sun, all the land of Gilead, the men of Gad and of Reuben and of Manasseh, from Aroer, by the river Arnon, even Gilead and Bashan.

entries.title: II Kings 10:34
segments: And the rest of the acts of Jehu and all that he did, and all his might, [are] they not written in the Book of the Matter of the Days of the Kings of Israel?

entries.title: II Kings 10:35
segments: And Jehu slept with his fathers. And they buried him in Samaria. And Jehoahaz his son reigned in his place.

entries.title: II Kings 10:36
segments: And the days that Jehu reigned over Israel and Samaria [were] twenty-eight years.
